name: Ripuka Gel
desc: A bottle filled with highly refined extracts of flammable plants. A tiny spark would be enough to ignite the liquid into a fire that would burn for a long, long time, and be a disaster for the user.

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - 1st Stratum
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a slot on the line closest to the Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Element Resonance - Fire
eff.desc1: Increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1] when used as an ingredient for a fire element synthesized item.
